```{r}
library(INLA)
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```

# PCA — Census 2017

```{r}
censo_2017<- read.csv("./data/censo_2017/01.censo_final_loreto_2017.csv") %>%
  mutate(ubigeo = as.character(ubigeo))

censo_pca<- read.csv("./data/censo_2017/censo_2017_pca_20.csv") %>%
  mutate(ubigeo = as.character(ubigeo))

censo_loreto_sinid<- censo_2017 %>% select(-ubigeo, -c3_p1_3, -c3_p1_6)

pca<- prcomp(censo_loreto_sinid, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

cor(pca$x[, 1], censo_pca$pc1[match(censo_2017$ubigeo, censo_pca$ubigeo)])
```

## Explained variance

```{r}
tibble(PC = paste0("PC", 1:10),
       var_exp = pca$sdev[1:10]^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)) %>%
  mutate(cum_var = cumsum(var_exp)) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = md("**Explained variance — Census 2017 PCA**")) %>%
  fmt_percent(columns = c(var_exp, cum_var), decimals = 1)
```

## PC1 loadings

```{r}
loadings_pc1<- tibble(variable = rownames(pca$rotation),
                      loading = pca$rotation[, "PC1"]) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(loading)))

loadings_pc1 %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = md("**PC1 — top 20 loadings (absolute value)**")) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = loading, decimals = 3)
```

# Final model fits

```{r}
edu_fits<- readRDS("./data/models/edu_fits.rds")
wi_fits<- readRDS("./data/models/wi_bb_fits.rds")

fit_edu<- edu_fits$m3$fit
fit_wi<- wi_fits$m3$fit
```

# PC1 coefficient

```{r}
bind_rows(
  fit_edu$summary.fixed %>% rownames_to_column("term") %>% mutate(Indicator = "EDU"),
  fit_wi$summary.fixed %>% rownames_to_column("term") %>% mutate(Indicator = "WI")
) %>%
  filter(term == "pc1") %>%
  transmute(Indicator, mean, sd,
            lower = `0.025quant`, median = `0.5quant`, upper = `0.975quant`) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = md("**Posterior summary of the PC1 coefficient (m3)**")) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = -Indicator, decimals = 3)
```

# Rural coefficient (EDU)

```{r}
fit_edu$summary.fixed %>%
  rownames_to_column("term") %>%
  filter(term == "rural") %>%
  transmute(mean, sd,
            lower = `0.025quant`, 
            median = `0.5quant`, 
            upper = `0.975quant`) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = md("**Posterior summary of the rural coefficient — EDU (m3)**")) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = everything(), decimals = 3)
```

# Hyperparameters

## EDU

```{r}
fit_edu$summary.hyperpar %>%
  rownames_to_column("parameter") %>%
  mutate(prec = str_starts(parameter, "Precision"),
         median = if_else(prec, 1/sqrt(`0.5quant`), `0.5quant`),
         lower = if_else(prec, 1/sqrt(`0.975quant`), `0.025quant`),
         upper = if_else(prec, 1/sqrt(`0.025quant`), `0.975quant`),
         parameter = str_replace(parameter, "Precision", "SD")) %>%
  select(parameter, median, lower, upper) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = md("**Hyperparameters — EDU (m3)**")) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = -parameter, decimals = 3)
```

## WI

```{r}
fit_wi$summary.hyperpar %>%
  rownames_to_column("parameter") %>%
  mutate(prec = str_starts(parameter, "Precision"),
         median = if_else(prec, 1/sqrt(`0.5quant`), `0.5quant`),
         lower = if_else(prec, 1/sqrt(`0.975quant`), `0.025quant`),
         upper = if_else(prec, 1/sqrt(`0.025quant`), `0.975quant`),
         parameter = str_replace(parameter, "Precision", "SD")) %>%
  select(parameter, median, lower, upper) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = md("**Hyperparameters — WI (m3)**")) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = -parameter, decimals = 3)
```
